exposure: Fetal heart rhythm abnormalities (tachycardia: sinus tachycardia, supraventricular tachycardia, atrial flutter; bradycardia: sinus bradycardia, atrial bigeminy, complete AV block; isolated extrasystoles)
outcome: Incidence of fetal heart rhythm disorders
cohort: The study examined 7863 fetuses, including 182 multiple gestations, who underwent fetal echocardiography for prenatal diagnosis.
finding: Out of 7863 fetuses examined, 572 (7.23%) had pathological heart features, and 127 (1.61%) had some form of rhythm disorder, with isolated extrasystoles being the most frequently diagnosed.
cross-section timing: Prenatally, with diagnoses made at very early stages of pregnancy via fetal echocardiography.
